description: The download link for one postal area's printable PDF report (composite scores, trends and the full statistics table). Returns a URL and never the file itself — the report renders the same data the other tools return, so offer the link when someone wants the document, and answer questions from get_place_stats instead. Downloading requires Suomiatlas Pro or an Area Pass for that area; when the caller has neither, the link still comes back and `locked` says what it costs. Reports exist per postal area only, not per municipality.

language.description: Report language: fi (default), sv or en.

place.description: Postal area name or 5-digit code, e.g. "Toukola", "00560"

year.description: Statistics year; defaults to the newest.

name: get_area_report
title: PDF report link for a Finnish postal area
